name: Torrent Search
description: Search for movies and TV shows via Jackett/Prowlarr, download via qBittorrent or embedded MonoTorrent, and auto-sync to Jellyfin library
overview: Full-featured torrent search and download integration for Jellyfin with Jackett/Prowlarr support, qBittorrent/MonoTorrent clients, TMDB metadata enrichment, and automatic library synchronization.

versions.changelog: Initial release - Search movies/TV via Jackett/Prowlarr (Torznab API), Download via qBittorrent WebAPI or embedded MonoTorrent (ARM64 native), TMDB metadata enrichment with NFO generation, Auto-organization to Jellyfin naming convention, Dashboard UI with search, download queue, settings
